subject.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate chat send and abort regression tests

question: Should this protected maintainer-requested Gateway test consolidation land after a current-base matrix review and inspectable focused-run evidence are attached?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and automation cannot independently confirm that the table-driven cases retain every intended distinction from the removed tests.

options.title: Review and land the consolidation
options.body: Confirm each named table case preserves the former abort, delivery, media, authorization, and transcript assertions, then accept a redacted focused Testbox transcript.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Ask for the refactor to be split if the refreshed merge diff makes any scenario mapping difficult to audit.

recommendation.title: Review and land the consolidation
recommendation.body: Confirm each named table case preserves the former abort, delivery, media, authorization, and transcript assertions, then accept a redacted focused Testbox transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the stated requester and sole author of the consolidation commit.
